edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — a dash whose recast yanks him to you; there is no stun in it. 13s at rank 1, so step up once it is spent. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His dash, recast to yank himself in — no stun in it. 13s at rank 1, so step up once it's gone.

edits.before: This is your half of the lane. Once you hit a couple items and especially level 16, your fully ranged kit fires AoE waves on every attack and your E shreds his health with percent-missing-HP damage, while R invulnerability blanks his all-in burst — he's an AP bruiser, not a true hyper-scaler, so you out-scale him outright. Kite his E engage, never face-tank inside his Q zone, and keep enough distance that his Kingslayer heal can't sustain through your DPS. Just remember he can steal your R at any point, so don't telegraph it before he's blown his engage.
edits.after: This is your half of the lane. Once you hit a couple items and especially level 16, your fully ranged kit fires AoE waves on every attack and your E shreds his health with percent-missing-HP damage, while R invulnerability blanks his all-in burst — he's an AP bruiser, not a true hyper-scaler, so you out-scale him outright. Kite his E engage, never face-tank inside his Q zone, and carry Grievous Wounds: Kingslayer heals off you every 6s at rank 5 and drags out any fight you let close. Remember he can steal your R, so don't telegraph it before he has blown his engage.

notes: Abscond/Abduct applies no CC to you — the recast pulls Sylas to his target. The page's headline 'dash + stun' was wrong in two places. Hijack copying Divine Judgment is already covered correctly in spikes[1] and mid.
